Market today: The mood around AI is mixed. While a major AI company just secured significant funding, suggesting continued investment, headlines also warn of AI's costly build-out complicating inflation and a 'Big Short' investor seeing an Achilles' heel. This creates a complex backdrop for your tech/chip-heavy book.

Your holdings: Your leveraged positions, SOXL (-41.13%) and SPAL (-38.45%), are deep in the red and need immediate attention. Leveraged ETFs decay over time, and trading on margin amplifies these drawdowns significantly. The rest of your book looks fine today.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the evolving AI narrative – whether the build-out continues to attract capital or if the 'Achilles' heel' warnings gain traction. Also, monitor your leveraged positions for further decay.

Bottom line: Aggressively manage your leveraged positions; the AI story is complex and demands careful risk management.
plays: Your Direxion Daily Semiconductor Bull 3X (SOXL) is down -41.13% and decays; consider trimming or tightening your stop from 200 to protect capital on this leveraged position.
SPAL, a new leveraged ETF, is down -38.45%; respect its stop at 21.38 or consider reducing exposure to manage risk on margin.
If looking to add to chips, Marvell (MRVL) has a scanner long setup at 226.76-226.54 with a stop at 225.1, aligning with the AI build-out theme.
